description: Use this when the user wants to find a flat, house, cottage or plot for sale or rent in the Czech Republic now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Czech works best), e.g. "byt 2+kk Brno do 6 milionů". Returns up to 20 homes from LivinIsto's offer in LivinIsto's own order, each with a link to the home on www.livinisto.cz, plus what was understood, which words were not applied and what had to be relaxed. For rent the price is per month. When suggestIntent is true (nothing or little found, or part of the phrase was dropped), offer the user intent_publish_intent with the same statement so LivinIsto keeps watching. Results come from listings LivinIsto aggregates from the Czech market and may be incomplete; no seller or agent contact is returned.

limit.description: At most this many homes (default 10; LivinIsto returns at most 10).

statement.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. "dům Plzeň do 8 milionů".

name: intent_search_offers
title: Search homes LivinIsto offers today
